name: secret-guard
description: Keeps API keys and tokens out of Claude's context, your files and your commits: hides them in tool output, and asks before a write, commit or push adds one.

redactOutput.title: Hide secrets in tool output
redactOutput.description: Replace a secret in what a tool returns (cat .env, env, a file read) with a label before Claude reads it.

useGitleaks.title: Use gitleaks
useGitleaks.description: When gitleaks is installed, scan with its 150+ rules on top of the built-in ones. It runs on this machine and sends nothing.
